title: How a breadboard connects
circuit: No circuit to build: tap the holes to see which ones are joined

intro_lesson.title: Which holes are joined?
intro_lesson.idea: Under the holes of a breadboard are hidden metal clips. The 5 holes in one short row on one side are joined by one clip. The long + and - lines are each joined all the way along.
intro_lesson.question: You put one leg in row 10, hole a. Which hole is joined to it?
intro_lesson.why: Holes a to e of the same row share one clip. Hole f is across the middle gap, on the other side.
